description: EXPLORATORY NON-RESULT: Peripheral determinant of M_CKM = m006(-5,2). Computed delta = 2.949e-4; PDG J_CKM = 3.06e-5. These differ by factor ~10. The claim delta ~ J_CKM does NOT hold. See SSRN 6775158 open problem #1. J_CKM = 0 is the HFG zeroth-order prediction.
note_formula: Formula uses REAL parts of log eigenvalues (= dilation exponents). Full complex Jacobian |det J_C| = 0.1917 overshoots by ~2500x. Only Re(log lambda) sub-Jacobian gives correct scale.
